title: Custom Application and Field Services: Conditions of Enrolment and Plan Acreage Ceilings
content:
Enrolment under Custom Application and Field Services is taken on one of six programmes, and the programme chosen fixes four conditions of entry, the one-off charge for opening the plan, and the most acres that plan may carry in a crop year.

## 1. Conditions of entry

Each programme is written for a least acreage, and acreage at that figure satisfies it. A programme may also call for a season acre commitment, for a current variable-rate prescription, or for the applicator licence to be verified.

| Programme | Least acres the programme is written for | Season acre commitment called for | Prescription called for | Applicator licence verification called for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | 0 acres | No | No | No |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | 300 acres | Yes | No | No |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | 500 acres | Yes | No | Yes |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | 500 acres | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | 1500 acres | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | 200 acres | No | No | Yes |

## 2. Enrolment charge and acre ceiling

| Programme | Charge for enrolling the plan (USD) | Most acres one plan may carry in a crop year |
|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | 0.00 | 2000 acres |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | 150.00 | 4000 acres |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | 350.00 | 6000 acres |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | 500.00 | 6000 acres |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | 1200.00 | 12000 acres |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | 250.00 | 5000 acres |

The charge is raised once on the enrolment and not per pass. The ceiling is an acreage the single plan may carry over the crop year, not an acreage per work order.

## 3. Worked illustration of the entry conditions (hypothetical)

A member farming 500 acres, on hypothetical figures, is at the least acreage the Full-Service Agronomy Plan and the Variable Rate Prescription Plan are each written for, and above the least acreage of the Season Commitment Application Plan and of the Certified Anhydrous Application Plan. Of those four, the two that stand at 500 acres also call for the applicator licence to be verified, and the Variable Rate Prescription Plan calls for a prescription as well. The same member is below the 1500 acres the Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan is written for.
